description: This account's notification inbox and settings, the same as the app's bell. feed: GET notifications/feed params {filter all|mentions|verified, limit 1-25, cursor}; defaults all and 25; continue with next as cursor for the same account and filter; verified currently returns no items; item: GET notifications/items/{itemId} itemId is the notification UUID; read: POST notifications/read body {action read, ids} (1-25 unique UUIDs) or {action read_all}; settings: GET notifications/settings; set_settings: POST notifications/settings body {confirmation SET_NOTIFICATION_PREFERENCES, expectedRevision from settings, channels {grade, doctor, settle, rounds, linemove, tail, rank} as booleans, pushRoast boolean}. Confirm the requested change with the customer before a write. A valid write is sent without a separate MCP preview unless the action says otherwise.
